name: Correspondence Notification 1
definition: Specifies the details of a notification, including identification and type.

SenderNotificationIdentification.name: Sender Notification Identification
SenderNotificationIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the sender, and sent to the receiver to unambiguously identify the notification.||Usage: The sender has to make sure that SenderNotificationIdentification is unique per receiver for a pre-agreed period.

NotificationType.name: Notification Type
NotificationType.definition: Identifies the type of notification and what the message content relates to.

NotificationSubType.name: Notification Sub Type
NotificationSubType.definition: Sub type of a notification.||Usage: The notification sub type element may be used to identify a department within a party to whom the notification can be directed to, for routing purposes. It should only be used when the notification type could logically be directed to different departments within a party, for example account terms and conditions.

NotificationNarrative.name: Notification Narrative
NotificationNarrative.definition: Provides information about the notification in narrative form.

EnclosedFile.name: Enclosed File
EnclosedFile.definition: Document enclosed in the message, such as account terms and conditions.||Usage: The use of the EnclosedFile element must be bilaterally agreed.

RelatedNotificationData.name: Related Notification Data
RelatedNotificationData.definition: Additional information related to the notification that will be sent or made available seperately, such as account terms and conditions.

NotificationNarrativeOrEnclosedFilePrese.definition: NotificationNarrative must be present or EnclosedFile must be present. Both may be present.
